items.title_original: 中国軍機の動向について
items.summary: Japan's Joint Staff reported on October 13 that a Chinese military Y-9 intelligence-collection aircraft flew over the East China Sea between waters southwest of the Danjo Islands and northwest of Okinawa's main island before returning toward the continent. Japan said Air Self-Defense Force fighter aircraft scrambled in response. The account is attributed to the Japanese government.
caveats: The Japanese government report is one institutional account, not independently confirmed flight data.
The original does not establish a territorial airspace violation, completed interception, contact, or hostile encounter.
The original flight map and photograph are linked at the publisher and are not copied into this packet.
